steps.title: Login screen — initial state
assertions: I agree to receive updates via WhatsApp, SMS, and calls.
steps.notes: Live-verified corrections: 'WheelsEye' wordmark is a plain logo image (ImageView) with no content-desc/text in the accessibility tree — omitted, it does not hold via a live contains check even though it renders as text in the screenshot. 'terms & conditions' is written with the XML-escaped ampersand (&) because contains/assert-all do a literal substring match against the raw XML source, where a real on-screen '&' is always serialized as '&'.

steps.title: Send OTP with empty phone number — validation error
steps.notes: Doc's provisional error text 'Please enter the details' confirmed exact live; no separate distinct field-level error text exists beyond the field label.

steps.title: Enter phone number, send OTP — OTP screen
steps.notes: The phone-number EditText itself has no content-desc/text, so the '+91' country-code prefix badge (clickable=false, fully inside the EditText's bounds) is used as the tap selector to focus it before typing. Live-verified correction: 'Didn't receive OTP?' uses a curly right single quote (U+2019 ’), not a straight apostrophe as the doc originally had.

steps.title: Incorrect OTP entered — error
steps.notes: OTP entry field is auto-focused as soon as the OTP screen loads, so no tap is needed before typing. Live-verified correction: actual error text is 'Please enter the correct OTP' — the doc's provisional guess ('Please enter correct OTP') was missing 'the'.

steps.title: Back to login, open password screen
steps.notes: 'back' from the OTP screen returns to the login screen (phone number field retains its value); 'Continue with password' opens the password screen with phone number pre-filled and the password field auto-focused/empty.

steps.title: Incorrect password entered — error
steps.notes: Password field is auto-focused/empty on screen landing, no tap needed. Live-verified correction: actual error text is 'Incorrect UserName or Password' (shown under both the phone number and password labels) — the doc's provisional guess ('Please enter the details') did not match.

steps.title: Correct password — successful login, Home page
steps.notes: Re-opens a fresh password screen (phone pre-filled, password field empty & auto-focused) instead of clearing the previous incorrect password in place, avoiding any need for a selector on the unlabeled password EditText. Live-verified correction: the Loads tab's underlying content-desc is 'Loads' (title case) even though it renders visually as all-caps 'LOADS' via text-transform styling — the doc's 'LOADS' does not match the live accessibility tree. The post-login 'Unauthenticated App Detected' dialog and notification-permission prompt (see application/known-behaviors.md) did not appear during this compile pass (likely already dismissed/granted earlier in this emulator session) so no dismiss actions were added; a future run hitting them fresh will diverge and can be locally recovered/patched then.
